Disposable subscription returned by the FluentValidation integration's subscription API; detaches the validator's edit-context handlers when disposed.

members.name: Clear
members.description: Clears both layers and notifies the EditContext.

members.name: Dispose
members.description: Unsubscribes from the EditContext and clears all messages this subscription owns.

members.name: SetExternalFailures
members.description: Replaces the external failure layer (server-side / out-of-band failures) and re-renders the store. Null or empty clears the layer. Local messages are untouched.

items.description: A Blazor component that integrates FluentValidation with EditForm. Place inside an EditForm to enable FluentValidation-based validation. Works as a drop-in replacement for DataAnnotationsValidator.

members.name: Dispose
members.description: Unsubscribes from EditContext validation events and releases resources.

members.name: Subscription
members.description: The options-driven subscription handle; null unless was supplied.

items.description: Extension methods for to register FluentValidation validators via assembly scanning.

Adapts a FluentValidation IValidator<T> to data-import row validation: each DataImportRow is bound to the model and validated; every failure becomes a DataImportRowError carrying the source row number and the target field key (default mapping lower-cases the first letter of the property name, overridable). Binder exceptions become whole-row errors instead of crashing the batch.

FluentValidation-based IKycStepValidator for TmKycWizard. Each wizard step has its own rule set (person/company identity, documents with expiry, addresses, recursive ownership shares, declarations); failures carry indexed field paths and localization keys instead of display text. The optional constructor delegate supplies the reference date for expiry/birth-date rules.
